How every pathway protects you.

  • Broad fixed choices only—no narrative intake or uploads.
  • No account, server submission, saved history or external AI.
  • Official and qualified local sources are labeled and must be rechecked.
  • Directory results are not rankings, referrals or endorsements.
  • Paid status cannot change facts, safety guidance or organic relevance.
  • Professional, eligibility and emergency decisions remain with the responsible provider or authority.
